name: Udelartitan
sum: Udelartitan is a saltasauroid titanosaur from the Guichon Formation of Uruguay, known from fragmentary remains of at least two individuals.
wsnote: About 15-16 m long (Soto et al. 2024 as quoted by the Wikipedia revision).
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; found in 2006 at the Araujo locality near Quebracho.
material: Fragmentary remains of at least two individuals.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Soto et al. 2024
